title: manage_notes
description: Create, update, reorder, or delete notes in the session's notes panel. Use for summaries, key findings, action items, flashcards, or study guides.

action.description: The action to perform on the notes database.

note_id.description: Required for 'update' and 'delete'. The exact note ID or its 8-character prefix.

content.description: Required for 'create'. Optional for 'update'. The markdown text of the note. For flashcards or quizzes, format them nicely using Markdown headers and bold text.

title.description: Optional title for a new tab/note or title update for an existing note.

note_type.description: Optional semantic type for categorizing the note.

target.description: Target destination for 'create' only: 'session_pad', 'new_tab', or a specific note_id to append to.

is_pinned.description: Optional flag for 'update' to pin/unpin the note.

note_ids_in_order.description: Required for 'reorder'. The ordered list of note IDs.
